description: Explicit five-year sensitivity assumptions, not estimated causal effects.

ADU 5-year take-up.unit: share of detached SF stock over 5 years
ADU 5-year take-up.interpretation: Conditional take-up assumption; not a forecast.

Missing-middle 5-year redevelopment shar.unit: share of detached SF stock over 5 years
Missing-middle 5-year redevelopment shar.interpretation: Conditional redevelopment assumption; not a forecast.

Missing-middle net additional units per.parameter: Missing-middle net additional units per redevelopment
Missing-middle net additional units per.interpretation: 2-unit reform implies at least +1 net unit; higher cases allow stronger utilization of 2-6 unit entitlement.

TOD production uplift in exposed areas.parameter: TOD production uplift in exposed areas
TOD production uplift in exposed areas.unit: percent increase in baseline production in TOD exposure area
TOD production uplift in exposed areas.interpretation: Applied only to the share of housing stock represented as within 1/2 mile of major transit.

Parking reform share of baseline develop.parameter: Parking reform share of baseline development affected
Parking reform share of baseline develop.interpretation: Not every new development is constrained by a parking minimum.

Parking spaces avoided per affected unit.parameter: Parking spaces avoided per affected unit
Parking spaces avoided per affected unit.interpretation: Default is approximately consistent with Seattle evidence showing about 40% less parking after reform.

Parking construction cost per avoided sp.parameter: Parking construction cost per avoided space
Parking construction cost per avoided sp.interpretation: Default approximately matches Seattle implied savings per avoided parking space.

Parking cost-to-supply elasticity.interpretation: Converts project cost reduction into a conditional housing-production response.

Development fee savings per unit.interpretation: Challenge benchmark: $50,000 fees reduced 50%, giving $25,000 savings.

Development fee cost-to-supply elasticit.interpretation: Converts fee savings relative to project-value proxy into a conditional supply response.

benchmark_definitions.adu: One detached or semi-detached ADU of at least 600 square feet on an existing single-family parcel; no additional parking required.
benchmark_definitions.missing_middle: Allow 2–6 homes on single-family-only parcels, up to three stories; setbacks and lot coverage may be nonbinding.
benchmark_definitions.tod: Increase allowed density within half a mile (804.672 metres) of qualifying major fixed-guideway transit stops. Original exposure provenance remains incomplete in frozen mode.
benchmark_definitions.parking: Reduce or remove mandatory parking; developers may still voluntarily provide parking. Only the assumed avoided spaces on the affected development share generate savings.
benchmark_definitions.fee: Reduce all major development fee categories by 50% from the standardized $50,000-per-home benchmark, saving $25,000.
